cffReport

Source: R/cffReport.R
cffReport.Rd

Creates a report in markdown format for a provided list of repositories and or CITATION.cff files. The report starts with a compact summary table followed by full per-entry records, and ends with a section listing any repositories for which no CITATION.cff was found.

Usage

cffReport(repos, file = NULL, sortBy = "title", headingLevel = 2)

Arguments

repos

character vector of repository urls or links to CITATION.cff files to be scanned

file

character string naming a file the report should be written to. If NULL the report will be directly returned by the function.

sortBy

category by which the report should sort its entries

headingLevel

integer (1–6); Markdown heading level for individual entry titles passed through to cff2md. Default is 2 (##). Increase when embedding the output inside a larger document.

Value

the report in markdown format

Author

Jan Philipp Dietrich
